displayTitle: Return of the Jedi Coloring Book (1983)
synopsis: The Star Wars: Return of the Jedi Coloring Book was published by Kenner Products in 1983 and features illustrations by Susan Nelson. It shares the same title with two other Kenner coloring books, another published in 1983 and featuring Luke Skywalker on the cover, and one published in 1984 featuring Lando Calrissian.
title: Return of the Jedi Coloring Book (1983)
